grouped_leave_out.current_head: in-sample on fit (the Gate-B predictor was trained on the fit split); the predicted source uses the in-sample Gate-B seed 20260908
grouped_leave_out.mix: share of each training batch whose landing carrier is the paired Gate-B member's one-step prediction from the observed anchor (CV: seed 20260908; final head seed i: Gate-B seed i)
grouped_leave_out.rule: for every candidate (K, mix): per source (engine, predicted) and per (predicate, Delta) the threshold is the first maximiser of the pooled out-of-fold F1 over [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.98, 0.99]; the candidate's score is the mean of its engine and predicted macro F1 (mean over predicates x Delta, every phase) at those thresholds. Temporal head: the best K in {2, 3, 4} x mix in {0, 0.5}; single-frame head: the best mix for K = 1; ties to the smaller K, then the smaller mix. Fit split only; the rollout source reads the predicted thresholds.

interface:
Issue #113 item 3: a macro head with temporal context for the observable macro predicates.

Interface (declared before training; it is the same for engine-parsed and predicted carriers):

    head(history, delta) -> logits [B, 2]  (observable_macro.PREDICATES at that Delta)

``history`` is [B, K, 236]: ``history[:, -1]`` is the carrier being read at the landing frame f
(an engine-parsed carrier, or a predicted one), and ``history[:, -1 - j]`` is the carrier at frame
f - j * Delta, clamped at frame 0 (the decision frame absorbs earlier positions). The history
stride is the request's own Delta, so a Delta-step rollout supplies it natively: at the n-th
predicted landing a + n * Delta of a rollout anchored at frame a, the history holds the rollout's
earlier landings and, before a, the observed context carriers (``rollout_history``). K = 1 is the
single-frame head (the landing carrier only).

Features: the landing carrier and the K - 1 stride-Delta motion differences
(z_f - z_{f-Delta}, z_{f-Delta} - z_{f-2 Delta}, ...), standardised with training statistics and
clipped to +-CLIP (terminal frames of early-ending shots carry very large motion values). One MLP
per Delta: Linear(K * 236, HIDDEN) -> SiLU -> Linear(HIDDEN, 2); HIDDEN = 128 is the width of the
current single-frame ``CNNHybridPredictor.macro_head``.

Loss: class-balanced binary cross-entropy (pos_weight = negatives / positives per predicate and
Delta over the training rows), masked by label availability.

definitions.debounce_rule: smallest debounce k in [1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35] frames whose relapse rate (share of settle_k frames f with f + 15 <= last frame that have a moving frame in (f, f + 15]) is <= 0.05, pooled over the #104 fit stream and the retained N1, #93 and #94 captures
definitions.label_index: labels are indexed by the landing frame f = t + Delta of a Delta request issued at frame t
definitions.relation_to_110: #110 ORs single-frame labels over (f-Delta, f]; #113 does not adopt it: structure change compares debounced endpoints, settle requires rest over the whole window
definitions.rest: every present, simulated, dynamic body (birds included) has |v| <= 0.01 u/s and |omega| <= 0.01 deg/s (the engine stable_entered thresholds); moving[f] = some native step of frame f's interval (s_(f-1), s_f] is not at rest
definitions.settle: settle_Delta(f) = the launched bird was removed (engine entity_destroyed) at or before s_(f-D) AND moving[f-D+1..f] all false, with D = max(debounce, Delta); available iff f >= D
definitions.structure-change: structure-change_Delta(f) = S(f) != S(f-Delta), S(f) = the directed non-bird (supporter, supported) entity pairs present on more than half of the native steps of frame f's interval (frame 0: its single step); available iff f >= Delta
